info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Document Archiving Management API
info.description: The Document Archiving Management API enables users to manage the archiving process of banking documents efficiently. Through this API, consumers can update the archiving status, ensuring documents are properly organized and retrievable. Typical users include banking institutions and document management systems that require seamless integration for document lifecycle management. This endpoint specifically allows for modification of archiving details for specified documents, enhancing the overall operational workflow for document handling in financial services.
